story.title: How it started
story.p1: We met in the most ordinary way — a chat that was meant to last a minute and turned into a walk around Spytkowice. This place has been our shared landscape ever since.
story.p2: The proposal was quiet: rings, a date on a watch, and the decision that 27 November 2026 would be our day. We are happy to share this story with you.

slider.title: Favourite moments
slider.subtitle: The ceremony, leaving the church, and the first dance.

schedule.title: The day at a glance
schedule.subtitle: Sample times — this is how our day is planned.

gather.text: Guests meet at the parish church in Spytkowice.

welcome.text: Bread, salt and the first toast at Przystań Kabanos.

dance.text: We open the floor — then the party runs until morning.

couple.title: Sweetheart table
couple.text: Ewelina and Arkadiusz, witnesses Anna and Tomasz, and both sets of parents. Speeches after dinner land here.

brideFamily.title: Table 1 — bride’s family
brideFamily.text: Ewelina’s siblings, grandparents, aunts and uncles, and cousins on her mother’s side.

groomFamily.title: Table 2 — groom’s family
groomFamily.text: Arkadiusz’s closest family from Spytkowice: godparents, aunts, uncles and cousins.

friends.title: Tables 3–4 — friends
friends.text: University, work and travel companions. Table 3 is nearer the dance floor, table 4 faces the garden.

orchestra.title: Table 5 — the band
orchestra.text: Musicians and the sound engineer — a short dinner break between sets; instruments stay on stage.

locals.title: Table 6 — Spytkowice
locals.text: Neighbours, the parish choir and friends from the area. A named list is at the hall entrance.

menuFood.title: Wedding menu
menuFood.subtitle: Sample dishes — diets were collected in the attendance form.

welcome.title: Welcome · 16:30
welcome.text: Sparkling wine, juices, mint lemonade and trays of canapés, tartines and olives from the moment you enter.

soup.title: Soup · 17:30
soup.text: Hot course: roasted pumpkin cream with toasted seeds. A milder red borscht for children.

main.title: Main · 18:15
main.text: Hot course: pork tenderloin in mushroom sauce or baked salmon. Vegetarian pumpkin risotto if you marked it on the attendance form.

dessert.title: Dessert · 20:30
dessert.text: Wedding cake after the first dance, ice cream and a sweet buffet (meringue, mini éclairs, fruit).

late.title: Late supper · 23:30
late.text: Żurek in a bread bowl, pastries and mini bakes — fuel for oczepiny.

logistics.title: Need to know
logistics.subtitle: Travel, shuttle, children and rooms in one place.

travel.title: Getting there
travel.text: The church and the reception are both in Spytkowice — a short drive from the parish (Spytkowice 21) to Przystań Kabanos (Spytkowice 625). Parking at the venue.

kids.title: Children
kids.text: Children are welcome. High chairs, a quiet corner and an animator in a side room.

stay.title: Rooms
stay.text: Rooms at Przystań Kabanos — request a stay in the attendance form; spaces are limited.

bus.title: Guest shuttle
bus.text: A hired 20-seat bus. 15:45 departure from the church in Spytkowice, at the venue around 16:20. Return from Przystań Kabanos at 3:45. Mark a seat in the attendance form.

animator.title: Children’s animator
animator.text: From 17:00 to 22:00 in the room next to the dance floor, Kasia runs games, face painting and a craft corner (ages 3–10). Parents stay at the party — note childcare on the attendance form.

gifts.title: Instead of flowers
gifts.subtitle: Your presence is the gift. If you would like to add something, these two are most welcome.

house.title: Envelopes for the house
house.text: If the envelope holds more than wishes, it goes towards building our home: the foundations, the windows, and the first kitchen we share. Every złoty is another brick.

wine.title: Wine
wine.text: A favourite bottle for the cellar — red, white or something from Małopolska.

guestbook.title: Guest book
guestbook.subtitle: A few words that stayed with us. Want to add yours? Send an email.

one.name: Uncle Marek
one.text: The welcome tartare was so good I took a second portion “for science”. Then a third, to confirm the findings.

two.name: Aunt Bożenka
two.text: Lovely flowers, really — only that ecru next to the runner. I would have gone more cream. But the bride decides. Still a better bouquet than Kasia’s last year.

three.name: Cousin Krzysiek
three.text: Przystań Kabanos, and the GPS led to Spytkowice. I stood in the car park looking for a harbour by the water. No harbour. The żurek in a bread bowl — that showed up.

witnesses.title: Witnesses
witnesses.subtitle: Questions about the bus, rooms or seating — write to Ania or Tomek.

contact.title: Ewelina and Arkadiusz
contact.subtitle: On the wedding day, a phone call is the quickest way to reach us.

partners.title: We recommend
partners.subtitle: The same studios that got us ready for the wedding — book before the ceremony or before the next-day party. Sample offers for this presentation.

makeup.offer: Bridal makeup with a trial, plus looks for the maid of honour and the bride’s mother. An all-day package with touch-ups before the first dance.

florist.offer: Bridal bouquet, boutonnière, church flowers and table arrangements in beige, green and dried stems.

hair.offer: A trial updo, curls and a braid for the veil. Travel to Spytkowice on the wedding morning from 8:00.

tailor.offer: Dress alterations, veil hemming, made-to-measure bow ties and waistcoats. Last stitches up to three days before.

band.offer: A highland band for the welcome, oczepiny and encores until dawn. Two sets plus a DJ in the break; PA included.

photo.offer: Coverage from getting ready to oczepiny, portraits in Spytkowice, and an online gallery within 21 days.
